prompt: An art studio with an artist working on a painting. The artist is holding a paintbrush and facing a fresh, new canvas on an easel. Behind the easel, there is a window. A palette with multiple paint colors sits on a wooden table next to the easel. The artist is pointing at a specific area on the canvas. On the floor under the table, there is a cat sleeping on a paint-splattered cloth. A sculpture of a bird sits on top of a pedestal in the corner. A jar of paintbrushes is positioned between the palette and a stack of older, used canvases; the fresh canvas on the easel is visibly brighter than the canvases in the stack. The number of brushes in the jar is four more than the number the artist is holding. There are two red paint tubes and a group of blue paint tubes scattered around the palette. The number of blue tubes is twice the number of red tubes. A small stool sits next to the pedestal. The artist is taller than the stool.
